A 500 m² rural plot a unique opportunity for anyone wishing to build their own retreat.

Situated in a prime location, this property combines the tranquillity of the outskirts with proximity to the town centre, offering a lifestyle that values contact with nature without sacrificing essential amenities.

Ideal for projects that prioritise cosy, well-lit spaces. 

Furthermore, it features a garden and fruit trees that create a natural and inviting setting for family leisure time or even for personal gardening.

The location is a real highlight: situated in a residential and commercial area, it enjoys stunning views of the mountains, countryside, pine forest and green spaces. 

It is close to schools, supermarkets, shopping centres, hospitals, pharmacies, banks and essential services such as the post office. 

It also boasts excellent transport links: public transport, the metro, the motorway and a river terminal are all nearby.

Although it does not have road frontage or mains drainage, the potential of this plot is undeniable, whether for building or for agricultural use. 

And for greater flexibility, an exchange is possible.
